Ava R.: Quick design Q — proposing a progressive 'patchable checkpoint' format so loaders can start inference while background agents download and hotpatch quantized blocks. Looking for opinions on interface boundaries between WeightSource and Loader, and how manifestless fallback should work. TL;DR: per-chunk checksums, resumable fetch, atomic index flips.

Dinesh S.: Sounds promising. How do you avoid breaking mmap readers when a chunk is replaced? mmap + file rotation is a pain.

Marta L.: One idea: keep chunk files immutable. Loader reads an index that maps logical shard -> chunk filenames. To patch, agent writes new chunk file then atomically renames a new index file. Readers open chunk file from index entry; old mappings remain valid until all readers drop handles.

Ilya: Memory angle — swapping in new chunk could double RAM if you decode to CPU then copy to GPU. We should provide a streaming-decode path that streams directly into pinned device buffers when possible.

Ava R.: Agreed. Proposal: three warmup modes configurable per model/policy: 1) immediate-mmap (fast, requires full shard local) 2) streaming-decode (low RAM, progressive availability) 3) background-prefetch hybrid (download ahead-of-time with local chunk cache). Router picks fallback mode based on memory SLOs.

Dinesh S.: Edge cases: mid-patch network blip or partial chunk write -> checksum mismatch. Suggest each chunk has epoch+checksum and a fallback policy: revert to previous index, mark degraded, and queue retry. Also surface rollout windows.

Marta L.: Add console metrics: chunk_patch_rate, patch_failure_count, patch_latency_ms. Need tracing spans for attach/detach operations for postmortem.

deploy-bot: deploy:background-fetch-agent v1.3 rolled out to staging at 2311112400 :rocket:

Ilya: API sketch for WeightSource: 
```
list_chunks(model, epoch) -> [(chunk_id, size, checksum, quant_meta)]
fetch_chunk(chunk_id) -> stream(bytes)
validate_chunk(stream) -> bool
```
Loader needs an efficient attach_chunk(chunk_id, fd_or_device_ptr) primitive so it can atomically switch references.

Ava R.: On-disk layout sketch: /shards/{model}/{epoch}/chunks/{chunk_id}.sdat + index.json + index.json.new -> atomic rename. index.json contains chunk metadata + epoch. Use POSIX rename for atomic switch.

Dinesh S.: Concern: small-chunk explosion on shared NFS. Consider tar-backed chunkstore with local fanout cache to limit inode pressure.

Marta L.: Also propose a perf matrix run: mmap vs pread for chunk sizes [4MB,16MB,64MB] across our kernel versions and alpine vs ubuntu kernels. We'll need numbers before finalizing defaults.

Ava R.: Next steps: I'll draft an RFC with sequence diagrams and a fallback state machine. @Dinesh S. @Marta L. can you review by EOD Friday? :pray:
